effects.printed_clause: If all monsters you control are Normal Monsters: change a face-up monster to face-down Defense.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation requires at least one own monster and no facedown/non-Normal own monster, targets any turn-settable face-up monster, and changes position.

official_references.matched_structure: Phantasm Spiral Trap condition based on controlling only Normal Monsters and targeted field interaction.

effects.printed_clause: If Umi is on field, activate this Trap from hand.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Phantasm Spiral Trap can activate from hand while Umi is present.

effects.printed_clause: Banish from GY, target a Normal Monster you control; equip a Phantasm Spiral Equip from Deck. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: GY ignition banishes as cost, targets a face-up Normal Monster with a legal Deck Equip candidate, then directly equips it; HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Phantasm Spiral GY effect banishes itself, targets a Normal Monster and equips qualifying Phantasm Spiral Equip cards.

coverage_override.reason: Hand activation under Umi, the position-changing Trap activation, and the GY banish/equip effect with its HOPT are exactly the three distinct effects.
